rules.condition_select: PREFIX ex: <http://example.org/ev#> SELECT ?e ?eid ?ts ?cp ?power WHERE { GRAPH <urn:window> { ?e <urn:prop:role> "driver" ; <urn:prop:type> "ChargeRequest" ; <urn:prop:eid> ?eid ; <urn:prop:timestamp> ?ts ; <urn:prop:cp> ?cp ; <urn:prop:power> ?power . } GRAPH <urn:state> { ?cp a ex:ChargingPoint ; ex:chargingPower ?current . } }

PREFIX ex: <http://example.org/ev#> SELECT ?e ?eid ?ts ?cp ?power WHERE { GRAPH <urn:window> { ?e <urn:prop:role> "fleet" ; <urn:prop:type> "FleetSchedule" ; <urn:prop:eid> ?eid ; <urn:prop:timestamp> ?ts ; <urn:prop:cp> ?cp ; <urn:prop:power> ?power . } GRAPH <urn:state> { ?cp a ex:ChargingPoint ; ex:chargingPower ?current . } }

PREFIX ex: <http://example.org/ev#> SELECT ?e ?eid ?ts ?cp ?cap WHERE { GRAPH <urn:window> { ?e <urn:prop:role> "grid" ; <urn:prop:type> "CapacitySignal" ; <urn:prop:eid> ?eid ; <urn:prop:timestamp> ?ts ; <urn:prop:cp> ?cp ; <urn:prop:cap> ?cap . } GRAPH <urn:state> { ?cp a ex:ChargingPoint ; ex:chargingPower ?current . } }
rules._priority_rationale: Ordinary capacity targets follow emergency reductions (q5=0) and curtailment (q4=1).

Curtailment tightens the cross-target curtailment-consistency invariant, so it is scheduled AFTER the load-reduction action q5 (priority 0) that brings charging points into compliance. Constraint-tightening actions follow the actions that satisfy the constraint.
rules.condition_select: PREFIX ex: <http://example.org/ev#> SELECT ?e ?eid ?ts ?feeder WHERE { GRAPH <urn:window> { ?e <urn:prop:role> "grid" ; <urn:prop:type> "GridEmergency" ; <urn:prop:eid> ?eid ; <urn:prop:timestamp> ?ts ; <urn:prop:feeder> ?feeder . FILTER(?feeder = ex:Feeder1) } GRAPH <urn:state> { ?feeder a ex:Feeder ; ex:feederState ?current . } }

PREFIX ex: <http://example.org/ev#> SELECT ?e ?eid ?ts ?cp WHERE { GRAPH <urn:window> { ?e <urn:prop:role> "grid" ; <urn:prop:type> "GridEmergency" ; <urn:prop:eid> ?eid ; <urn:prop:timestamp> ?ts ; <urn:prop:feeder> ex:Feeder1 . } GRAPH <urn:state> { ?cp a ex:ChargingPoint ; ex:chargingPower ?current . FILTER(?current > 5.0) } }

FILTER(?current = "free") } }
